children: Anuvrat Jhawar takes charge as CFO from 22 September, with the appointment subject to confirmation by the board

Shivansh Finserve has appointed Anuvrat Jhawar as its Chief Financial Officer (CFO), effective 22 September 2026, according to a regulatory filing with the BSE. The appointment is subject to confirmation by the company’s board of directors and is aimed at supporting the company’s day-to-day financial and operational functions.

Jhawar brings experience across financial planning, financial reporting, regulatory compliance, finance, accounts and corporate management. His appointment places him in charge of the company’s finance function at a time when financial reporting and regulatory compliance remain key responsibilities for listed companies.
The company’s disclosure states that his experience in finance and corporate management will support its financial and operational activities.
Jhawar’s appointment took effect from 22 September 2026. The company has, however, stated that the appointment remains subject to confirmation by its board of directors.
The appointment was disclosed under Regulation 30 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements (LODR) Regulations, 2015.
The regulatory filing was signed by director Hiren Kishor Patel on 22 September.
As part of the disclosure, Shivansh Finserve stated that Jhawar is not debarred from holding the office of director by SEBI or any other regulatory authority.
The filing also provided the information required under the applicable SEBI circular and the BSE disclosure requirements concerning appointments of key managerial personnel.
The company has further disclosed that there are no relevant relationships between its directors in connection with the appointment.

As CFO, Jhawar will oversee the company’s finance-related responsibilities, including financial planning, reporting, accounts and regulatory compliance. The appointment is also intended to facilitate the smooth functioning of the company’s day-to-day activities.
The board’s confirmation will complete the appointment process. Until then, Jhawar’s appointment remains subject to the stated approval.
